chunks: Abul-Abbās narrated to me from Al-Zayyāt, from Ja’far ibn Bashīr, from Ḥammād, from Ibn Muslim, from ‘Āmir ibn ‘Umayr, and from Sa’īd Al-A’raj, from Abū ‘Abdillāh (peace be upon him), who said:
Go to the grave of Ḥusain (peace be upon him) once a year.

key_terms.الْحُسَيْنِ: Al-Husain ibn Ali (peace be upon him)
key_terms.زِيَارَة: Visitation/Pilgrimage to the grave of an Imam or Prophet
key_terms.قَبْرَ: Grave (specifically referring to the shrine of the Imam)

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum recommended frequency for visiting the grave of Imam al-Husain?
ai.summary: Recorded in Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) establishes the annual visitation of Imam al-Husain’s grave as a recommended minimum, anchoring the spiritual discipline of remembrance (dhikr) in physical pilgrimage. It underscores the enduring bond between the Ahl al-Bayt and the faithful, transforming the grave into a focal point for reconnecting with the legacy of the Prophet’s household. This practice is not merely ritualistic but serves as a continuous renewal of allegiance (wilayah) and a means of drawing closer to God through the intercession of the Imams.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 9. Abul ‘Abbās narrated to me from Al-Zayyāt, from Ja’far ibn Bashīr, from Ḥammād, from Ibn Muslim, from ‘Āmir ibn ‘Umayr, and from Sa’īd Al-A’raj, who said: Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said:
Go to (the Ziyārah of) the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.) once a year.
